title: Echinacea purpurea essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Echinacea purpurea essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the flowers and leaves of the echinacea plant, known for its immune-boosting properties. It is commonly used in herbalism to support the body's natural defenses against infections and colds. The oil is often diluted with a carrier oil before topical application to reduce skin irritation. It may also be used in aromatherapy to promote respiratory health and reduce inflammation. Herbalists recommend it as a natural remedy for enhancing immunity and alleviating symptoms of respiratory ailments.
